title: lepidocoma vestita
intro: Lepidocoma vestita, commonly known as the White-bellied Crested Gibbon Flower, is a plant species belonging to the family Tiliaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Lepidocoma vestita include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and soothe digestive issues, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
